direction: Cheerful clean marimba and woodblock: rounded pitched wooden notes, playful and restrained.
purpose: Sound Lab alternatives for user selection; not applied to gameplay.

notes: Exactly one successful take per category. No regeneration or fallback source.

clips.label: Bright wood tick
clips.prompt: One cheerful high marimba wood tick for picking up a game piece, about half a second. A single clean rounded wooden note, crisp friendly attack, light and playful, short natural resonance. Dry studio close-up, clear pitched musical wood. Only one hit, then quiet. No gritty foley, voice, piano, wobble, whoosh, hiss, bass thump, dark atmosphere or long reverb.
